The '''Three Beldons Buffet''' was one of the finest [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurants]] in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]. It was located near the [[Yarith Bespin/Legends|Yarith Bespin]] and the [[Figg & Associates Art Museum]] and was owned by [[Jolen Mandar]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
